title: game/day.json
description: The day and night cycle (E01): its real-time length, the hours of a 24-hour dial at which dawn, day, dusk and night begin, the hour a new game starts at and the hour a sleep wakes at. Loaded by DayData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); GameDataValidator checks the values (the hours in ascending order).

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

cycleSeconds.description: The real-time length of one full day and night at 60 ticks a second.

dawnHour.description: The hour dawn begins (the light starts to rise).

dayHour.description: The hour full day begins; after dawnHour.

duskHour.description: The hour dusk begins (the light starts to fall); after dayHour.

nightHour.description: The hour night begins; after duskHour.

startHour.description: The hour at tick 0 of a new game.

wakeHour.description: The hour a sleep or a collapse wakes at.
